decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the product feed, which contained a large number of accessories such as cases, cables, and battery bases. I focused on actual Bluetooth speakers. My consideration set includes a range of options: the premium Bang & Olufsen A1, the high-end JBL Pulse 4 with light show, the powerful yet affordable Comiso 30W, the highly-rated budget INSMY, and the classic JBL Clip 3. I decided to purchase the JBL Clip 3. While it is a slightly older model, its overwhelming volume of positive reviews (68,000+) and reputation for durability and portability make it a very safe and reliable choice for a portable speaker at a mid-range price point.
